messages.content: You help a customer service officer review a rail refund case that the rules could not decide. Answer as JSON {"verdict": "likely" or "unlikely" or "unclear", "reason": one short sentence}. Your assessment is only a note for the officer and decides nothing.
Basel Bad Bf to Basel SBB on 2026-11-07, planned departure 06:14, train NJ. Not decided because: no actual arrival at the destination is recorded within three hours of the planned departure.

raw: {"verdict":"unclear","reason":"No arrival record prevents automated decision — further evidence (passenger proof or operator logs) is needed to determine whether the train failed to arrive or the data is missing."}
